title: Manual attestation
description: A human attestation that a control state holds at a moment in time. v1.1 adds attestation_data, a free-form bag for control-specific fields that conform to the control bundle's manual_evidence_schema. v1.2 adds result (pass or fail) and fail_reason, which is required when result is fail. A payload without result is a pass, as every 1.0 and 1.1 attestation is. v1.3 adds the period the attestation covers (period_start and period_end, as dates) and report_reference, the report it came from, for prior-period results a historical import loads.
